description: Native search-policy overfit audit. This is not a promotion candidate: prove that the exported native .nn can learn a small Lichess policy target set before scaling the objective.

metadata.hypothesis: The search-aware objective and exported native .nn path must be able to overfit 64 non-mate policy targets on CPU. If it cannot, larger policy-target training is not justified.
metadata.init: Enyo-owned native SF-binpack checkpoint 2048; no Berserk initialization
metadata.gate: CPU search_target_model_gate must reach 64/64 top1 on both model.pt and exported model.nn

validation.promotion: not eligible for SPRT; this is an objective/export plumbing audit
validation.success: model.pt and exported model.nn both score 64/64 top1 on the 64 non-mate Lichess policy targets
validation.failure: any lower score means stop this objective before scale-up
